create_event: Add an event. Body: name, date (YYYY-MM-DD), capacity (whole number). Returns the event including its id.
get_event: Get one event by its id. Path params: id.
sign_up: Sign a person up for an event. Path params: id (the event). Body: name, phone. Refused when the event is full.
list_signups: List the people signed up for an event. Path params: id (the event).
